title: LegacyParams
description: Tenure and legacy parameters. SPEC-LEGACY-1: term length, reappointment threshold, and legacy score weights.

term_length_months.description: SPEC-LEGACY-1: length of a single Chair term in months. A reappointment is due at each term boundary.

reappointment_credibility_min.description: SPEC-LEGACY-1: minimum credibility score required for reappointment. Credibility >= this value means the Chair is reappointed.

legacy_credibility_weight.description: SPEC-LEGACY-1: weight applied to credibility in the legacy score formula.

legacy_mandate_bonus.description: SPEC-LEGACY-1: per-month bonus multiplier awarded when the mandate is on target.

legacy_anchor_penalty.description: SPEC-LEGACY-1: per-month penalty for each month credibility was below the anchor threshold.
